questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Il ne faut pas vendre la peau de l'ours avant de l'avoir tué.”
o: Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
Don't put all your eggs in one basket.
The early bird catches the worm.
Every cloud has a silver lining.
questions.e: “Don't count your chickens before they hatch.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Elle a pris son courage à deux mains.”
o: She changed her mind at once.
She plucked up the courage.
She kept her fingers crossed.
She let the cat out of the bag.
questions.e: “She plucked up the courage.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Nous devons remettre les choses en perspective.”
o: We need to put things off indefinitely.
We need to get our act together.
We need to put things into perspective.
We need to take things for granted.
questions.e: “We need to put things into perspective.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Il a fini par reconnaître son erreur.”
o: He denied having made a choice.
He suddenly changed the subject.
He barely noticed the result.
He eventually admitted his mistake.
questions.e: “He eventually admitted his mistake.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Cette décision a déclenché un débat animé.”
o: This decision sparked a lively debate.
This decision put an end to debate.
This decision came under fire silently.
This decision fell through the cracks.
questions.e: “This decision sparked a lively debate.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Elle a mis le doigt sur le vrai problème.”
o: She turned a blind eye to the problem.
She pinpointed the real problem.
She swept the problem under the rug.
She made a mountain out of a molehill.
questions.e: “She pinpointed the real problem.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Le projet a été reporté à la dernière minute.”
o: The project was carried out ahead of schedule.
The project was called off for good.
The project was postponed at the last minute.
The project was brought forward by a month.
questions.e: “The project was postponed at the last minute.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Ils ont trouvé un terrain d'entente.”
o: They went their separate ways.
They took the matter for granted.
They left no stone unturned.
They found common ground.
questions.e: “They found common ground.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Il faut tenir compte des conséquences.”
o: We must take the consequences into account.
We should take the matter for granted.
We can make up for the consequences.
We ought to get away with it.
questions.e: “We must take the consequences into account.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Son explication ne tient pas la route.”
o: Her explanation is right on the money.
Her explanation doesn't hold water.
Her explanation went down well.
Her explanation hit the nail on the head.
questions.e: “Her explanation doesn't hold water.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Il a profité de l'occasion pour poser une question.”
o: He missed the opportunity to answer.
He took the question with a grain of salt.
He seized the opportunity to ask a question.
He made the most of the delay.
questions.e: “He seized the opportunity to ask a question.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Ce changement a eu un effet inattendu.”
o: This change was taken into account.
This change was bound to happen.
This change made no difference at all.
This change had an unexpected effect.
questions.e: “This change had an unexpected effect.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Elle a dû faire face à plusieurs difficultés.”
o: She had to cope with several difficulties.
She managed to get over the deadline.
She turned down several opportunities.
She made up several difficulties.
questions.e: “She had to cope with several difficulties.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “L'entreprise cherche à réduire ses dépenses.”
o: The company is expected to raise its prices.
The company is seeking to cut its expenses.
The company has run out of products.
The company is taking on new staff.
questions.e: “The company is seeking to cut its expenses.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Il a beau s'entraîner, il reste nerveux avant les examens.”
o: He is nervous because he never practises for exams.
He stopped practising before the final exam.
Although he practises, he still gets nervous before exams.
He practises so that he can avoid studying.
questions.e: “Although he practises, he still gets nervous before exams.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “À moins d'un changement, le match aura lieu samedi.”
o: Even if nothing changes, the match took place yesterday.
Provided it changes, the match is cancelled.
As soon as it changed, the game will begin.
Unless something changes, the match will take place on Saturday.
questions.e: “Unless something changes, the match will take place on Saturday.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Nous sommes tombés sur une vieille photographie.”
o: We came across an old photograph.
We came up with an old photograph.
We looked down on the old photograph.
We got away with the old photograph.
questions.e: “We came across an old photograph.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Le rapport met en évidence les progrès réalisés.”
o: The report puts off the progress made.
The report highlights the progress made.
The report rules out any progress.
The report takes after the progress.
questions.e: “The report highlights the progress made.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Elle a refusé de tirer des conclusions hâtives.”
o: She refused to make ends meet.
She decided to take a rain check.
She refused to jump to conclusions.
She agreed to face the music.
questions.e: “She refused to jump to conclusions.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Le candidat a répondu avec beaucoup d'assurance.”
o: The candidate answered in a hurry.
The candidate spoke under pressure.
The candidate answered without a clue.
The candidate answered with great confidence.
questions.e: “The candidate answered with great confidence.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Il est peu probable que le prix baisse bientôt.”
o: The price is unlikely to fall soon.
The price is bound to rise tomorrow.
The price has been falling for years.
The price cannot be predicted at all.
questions.e: “The price is unlikely to fall soon.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Elle a tenu parole malgré les difficultés.”
o: She broke her promise because of the difficulties.
She kept her word despite the difficulties.
She took her time despite the difficulties.
She made her point without difficulty.
questions.e: “She kept her word despite the difficulties.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Le problème ne se limite pas au manque d'argent.”
o: The problem is no longer worth the money.
The problem is being solved without money.
The problem is not limited to a lack of money.
The problem is caused by too much money.
questions.e: “The problem is not limited to a lack of money.” is the best translation in this context.

questions.q: Choose the best English translation of: “Après mûre réflexion, ils ont changé d'avis.”
o: Without any warning, they made up their minds.
After a brief discussion, they kept their word.
With hindsight, they missed the point.
After careful consideration, they changed their minds.
questions.e: “After careful consideration, they changed their minds.” is the best translation in this context.
